name: 35023 · Hueytown, AL
findings: ZIP 35023 (Hueytown) has 60 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (23%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 35023 (Hueytown) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 35023 (Hueytown) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 29% of the typical level).
